symptom: `use building block PlatformDesignSystem.Avatar_Group_SM` (and Avatar_Group_XS) failed with `CreatePage: encode: CreatePage: ListView source <nil> is not supported by either engine — please file an issue`; a hand-written `listview` with no `DataSource:` passed `mxcli check` and failed the same way at exec
cause: listViewSourceToGen had no case for a nil source, so an unconfigured list view fell to the unsupported-type refusal written for unknown $Types. Separately, Forms$ListViewXPathSource registered only SourceVariable as a null field, so an XPath source with no entity omitted its EntityRef key
fix: A nil source is written as Studio Pro's unconfigured source: Forms$ListViewXPathSource with EntityRef and SourceVariable null, XPathConstraint '', ForceFullObjects false, empty SortBar/Search (EntityRef added to NullFields). exec warns; mx check reports CE0488 'No entity configured for the data source of this list view' until the author binds it
insight: The reference shape was already on disk: every unconfigured List View in the Atlas page templates of testdata/testapp (13, identical; 13 likewise in PedApp) — scan the Studio Pro-authored templates before asking for a Studio Pro example. A patched copy of a building block (a Studio Pro list view grafted in, $IDs AND the pointers to them renumbered — renumbering $IDs alone made mxbuild throw KeyNotFoundException while loading) reproduces a Marketplace block that is not downloadable. A block's unconfigured list view is not an mx check error in the block itself; only once placed on a page
